Thanks, everyone, for joining the launch planning meeting. We went through the feedback from the beta, and the main complaint is that the onboarding takes too long. After some discussion, we decided to move the public launch from the first of March to the fifteenth of April. Alice Johnson will rewrite the onboarding emails by Friday. The pricing page also has to be updated before the launch, but nobody has picked that up yet. That is everything for today. Thank you.
